name: Templar's Slash spends its charges on a Hero (#6568)
contract: Templar's Slash rank 7 (278753) is a SpellFamilyName 10 spell that SpellCharges.dbc links to charge category 100: 3 charges with an 8 second recharge. Spell.dbc gives it no cooldown of its own, so the charges are the only thing that limits it. ApplyClientSpellCharges only accepted custom class families 18 to 38, so a Hero's family 10 spell kept MaxCharges 0, ConsumeSpellCharge returned early and the spell could be cast endlessly. Three casts spend the three charges.
